Welcome! I'm Richard, a data scientist who came to the field via an Honours
Chemistry degree at McGill and a decade of decisioning and modelling work in
the UK. Most recently I was a Modelling and Data Science Manager, and before
that a Lead Decisioning Architect at Merkle, working with clients across
Europe. I'm now at UBC completing a Master of Data Science, where I'm
deepening the statistical and machine learning foundations behind the work
I was already doing. After the program I'm hoping to work on complex models in the technology sector.
